findings.title: Non-JSON quality gate returns success when leaked artifacts are its only failure
findings.evidence: success is false at line 131 for leaked_artifacts; JSON mode returns it at 150, but text mode checks only violations at 163-169 and unconditionally returns True at 173.
findings.trigger: Run audit_scripts_quality.py without --json with valid Python scripts and a disallowed non-hidden artifact in scripts/.
findings.impact: CLI exits zero and prints ALL SCRIPTS PASSED despite reporting an artifact leak; pre-commit/CI callers can accept a failed gate.

findings.title: Git history verifier treats Git errors as a clean history
findings.evidence: sh() runs git with check=False and returns only stdout (lines 31-35); exceptions also return an empty string. Lines 50-55 interpret empty output as no history.
findings.trigger: git log fails (corrupt repository, inaccessible object database, missing Git, or invocation outside a repository containing the expected config files).
findings.impact: Verifier can emit a green repository verdict without having successfully examined history, defeating the advertised secret-history check.

findings.title: FIFO lifecycle test deletes the native host shared queue
findings.evidence: Test imports production QUEUE_FILE then unlinks it at lines 104 and 120 without monkeypatching. scripts/c5_cli/moskv_native_host.py:181 sets QUEUE_FILE=/tmp/moskv_fx_queue.json.
findings.trigger: Run this unit test while the native messaging host has queued prompts.
findings.impact: Queued user work is deleted and the test mutates shared live state; parallel tests or host operations can interfere.

findings.title: CTRE commits non-finite drift observations
findings.evidence: No finiteness validation before percentile/mean; NaN propagates as var_limit when tail_risks is empty (31-39), and NaN > threshold is false at line 52.
findings.trigger: Call enforce_thermodynamic_brake with a NaN-containing list, including [float("nan")].
findings.impact: Returns ACTION_COMMIT and records a non-finite risk rather than rejecting invalid observations. Traced consumer eip7702_hunter.py:65-73 only updates counters/messages; no actual on-chain execution is established.

findings.title: Risk rounding precedes CTRE threshold enforcement
findings.evidence: cvar_risk is rounded to five decimals at line 50 before strict threshold comparison at line 52.
findings.trigger: Default threshold 0.015 and an observation such as 0.015004, whose CVaR exceeds the threshold but rounds to 0.015.
findings.impact: Reports ACTION_COMMIT despite exceeding the configured maximum risk. Observed consumer is a simulator/counter, not proven transaction execution.

findings.title: Simulated tier stress test certifies IDE behavior it never exercises
findings.evidence: Mocks at lines 15-38 return constant strings after sleeps; loop 96-99 runs sequentially; line 117 unconditionally declares IDE never blocked and empirical falsification passed.
findings.trigger: Run the PoC successfully, including cases where its mock latencies differ from real inference or IDE behavior.
findings.impact: Output can be mistaken for verification of actual IDE availability although no IDE state or real inference path is checked.
